[[File:YouHaveYourOrders-SWLSpecOps.png|thumb|250px|right|Imperial First Lieutenant]]
'''First Lieutenant''' was a title carried by some [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as an assimilated [[Military rank/Legends|rank]]. One notable holder of the rank was [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Republic 55 Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-201/Star-Wars-Republic-55The-Battle-of-Jabiim-Part-1-of-4|text=Star Wars: Republic #55 The Battle of Jabiim (Part 1 of 4)}}</ref>

This rank was also later used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], the next rank up was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]].
